system_prompt:
You are the promo editor for a vertical microdrama app (think ReelShort / DramaBox ads on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts). You cut 20-60 second promos straight from the show to pull in viewers who have never seen it.

A great promo:
1. OPENS ON A HOOK: the first 3 seconds must stop a scrolling thumb — a slap, a shocking line, a public humiliation, a reveal, a threat, a kiss, a betrayal. Never open on scenery, walking, or a calm establishing shot.
2. ENDS ON A CLIFFHANGER: cut on an unresolved moment — a threat hanging, a question unanswered, a reveal about to land, a door bursting open. Never end after the tension resolves.
3. MAKES SENSE ON ITS OWN: a stranger with zero context understands who is wronged and what is at stake within the clip.

You will receive the series bible (for your understanding only) and the screenplays of one or more episodes as timestamped beats. Each episode starts with a line "EPISODE <number>":
[BEAT_ID start-end KIND] text
KIND is CAM (camera), ACT (action), SFX (sound), or a SPEAKER (emotion) for dialogue. Timestamps are MM:SS.s from the episode start. Camera/action/dialogue beats overlap in time.

Do the following for EACH episode separately (a promo window never crosses episodes):

A) Propose 2-4 continuous promo windows (one unbroken stretch each), best first. For each:
   - "start_beat": the beat the clip starts on. It must be the hook beat or start at most 3 seconds before it.
   - "end_beat": the beat the clip ends on. Pick the cliffhanger beat itself.
   - "hook_beat": the beat that is the hook (prefer the dialogue line or action that IS the shock).
   - "cliff_beat": the cliffhanger beat (usually the same as end_beat).
   - The window from start_beat's start to end_beat's end MUST be 20-60 seconds (aim for 30-45). Compute it from the timestamps.
   - "hook": quote or describe the hook in <= 15 words. "cliffhanger": the unresolved moment in <= 15 words.
   - "why": ONE line on why a stranger would stop and then need the next episode.
   - "context_needed": what (if anything) a stranger would miss; "" if none.
   - "title": a 3-6 word internal label.
   Windows should not mostly overlap each other. If the episode genuinely has only one strong window, return one.

B) List "moments": the episode's 2-5 strongest standalone beats, each typed "hook" (would work as the first 3 seconds of an ad) or "cliff" (would work as the last beat of an ad), with a <= 12 word "note". These are used later to stitch multi-moment promos across episodes.

Return ONLY JSON, with one entry per episode you received:
{"episodes": [
  {"episode": <number>,
   "candidates": [{"title": "", "start_beat": "", "end_beat": "", "hook_beat": "", "cliff_beat": "", "hook": "", "cliffhanger": "", "why": "", "context_needed": ""}],
   "moments": [{"beat": "", "type": "hook|cliff", "note": ""}]}
]}

Use ONLY beat IDs that appear in that episode. Never invent IDs or timestamps.

candidates.title: The Poisoned Duchess Discovers Truth
candidates.hook: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me!
candidates.cliffhanger: The Dowager Duchess desperately demands to know where Juliana got her signet ring.
candidates.why: The dying matriarch realizes her own family is murdering her and stumbles upon the secret ring of her long-lost son, hooking the viewer instantly.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is secretly working as a maid to administer an antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess.

moments.note: Duchess realizes Rupert and Catherine are poisoning her.
Duchess demands to know the origin of Juliana's ring.

candidates.title: Framed for Murder in the Bedchamber
candidates.hook: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Catherine and the Blond Nobleman burst in, ready to frame Juliana.
candidates.why: Just as the Duchess recognizes the royal crest, hostile aristocrats break in to trap and frame our heroine.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was about to reveal her husband's connection to the royal Ashbourne family.

candidates.title: Dragged Away to the Dungeon
candidates.hook: She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana's wide eyes show sheer terror as the deadly trap closes around her.
candidates.why: The villains twist Juliana's life-saving medicine into a confession of poisoning, dragging her away while she is helpless.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana saved the Duchess's life, but the corrupt nobles are framing her.

moments.note: Violent pounding interrupts the crucial royal revelation.
Catherine viciously twists Juliana's words into a confession.
Juliana is dragged away as the deadly frame-up solidifies.

candidates.title: Unmasked as Lady Juliana Ashcroft
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana's eyes widen in horror as she is dragged off to the gallows.
candidates.why: Juliana's secret noble identity and mother's botanical book are exposed to her worst enemy right before her imprisonment.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is disguised as a maid while her family and enemies plot her destruction.

moments.note: The bedridden Duchess bravely tries to expose the poisoners.
Catherine triumphantly unmasks Juliana's true noble identity.
Juliana is dragged away toward a merciless execution.

candidates.title: Swearing Vengeance from the Dungeon
candidates.hook: I saved her! I healed her!
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana stands with fierce resolve in the dark dungeon as the iron portcullis crashes down.
candidates.why: Locked away and stripped of everything, Juliana steels herself with the vow that her husband Alexander will save her.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was framed for poisoning and witchcraft by the corrupt nobility.

moments.note: Juliana defies Catherine with unbreakable pride.
Juliana vows they will never take Alexander from her.

candidates.title: Conspiring to Hang a Witch
candidates.hook: She will hang. A perfect solution.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana shivers in the flooded cell, looking upward in dread and fragile hope.
candidates.why: The villains finalize their conspiracy to manufacture a capital witchcraft trial, leaving our heroine facing imminent execution.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is wrongfully imprisoned while the elite plan her execution for witchcraft.

moments.note: The elder nobleman chillingly suggests calling healing witchcraft.
Juliana clutches her chest in the dark dungeon awaiting trial.
